summary: GameSquare Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a September 8, 2026 Contribution Agreement whereby wholly owned subsidiary GameSquare IP Holdings will acquire substantially all assets of FanEngine Holdings Ltd., a UK private company, from seller FanEngine and its securityholders. Consideration is stock: GameSquare will issue common shares equal to 30% of post-issuance outstanding shares to the seller securityholders, plus assumed liabilities capped at $25,000 in trade payables, with $25,000 aggregate limit. No cash price, premium, or close date stated; closing is subject to conditions. Watch for dilution mechanics, Nasdaq approval, and any shareholder-approval or ownership-change constraints on the 30% issuance.
